description:
Cochlear Implant Support for Ivan

Rotary Club of Mumbai 25 was privileged to support Ivan D’Souza, a 6-year-9-month-old child diagnosed with bilateral profound hearing loss, by providing financial assistance for his cochlear implant and surgery. Rotary Club of Mumbai 25 co sponsored the surgery by contributing Rs. 1,25,000 for the implant and surgery.

The Surgery was successfully performed on 30 September 2026.

This project reflects Rotary’s commitment to transforming lives through meaningful service. By helping Ivan access the gift of hearing, RCom 25 has supported not just a medical procedure, but opened the door to better communication, education, confidence, and a brighter future.

RCom 25 is proud to be a part of Ivan’s journey from silence to sound.
